skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Tsukiyoi
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Tsukiyoi. Custom-made for Mint, integrating Victorian style into traditional Higashinese garb. Comfy yet unique, it is one of Mint's favorites on festive occasions.
skins.quote: 'I can't wait for the fair! All the fun activities, and the used book sale!'

skins.name: Private Study
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Private Study. Mint's formalwear at the Victorian Institution for Higher Studies, the green waistband showing off her lines and individuality.
skins.quote: The private study is filled with books, each filled with mysteries waiting to be solved. She comes here whenever she gets a rare moment to focus.
